text:
Switch character replies to Muse Spark

Call the Meta Model API chat endpoint from npc.js and keep the persona prompts as they are.

Transcribe what the runner says with Muse Voice

Add an endpoint that takes a 16 kHz mono WAV clip and returns the transcript.

Pass the challenge answers as recognition keywords

Passphrases get misheard; send the expected answers along so recognition favours them.

Refuse audio the transcriber can't take

Stereo, 8-bit or 44.1 kHz uploads should get a 415 instead of being forwarded.

Low reasoning effort for character replies

Replies take too long to come back; run them at low effort and time the wait.

In-world fallback line when the model says nothing usable

If the reply is empty or only markup, play one of the static-on-the-line lines.

Make the chat model configurable

Read the model name from .env so we can try a different one without a code change.

Characters must put safety first

If the runner mentions traffic, crossing a street or feeling unwell, the character tells them to stop before anything else.

Strip emoji and stage directions from replies

The phone's voice reads asterisks and emoji out loud.

Distinct on-device voices per character

With cloud voices gone, give HUSH, Vesper and SmartSpecs their own pitch and rate.

Smaller allowance of character replies for players without the event token

Signed-in players get a per-account limit so one person can't run up the bill.

Keep character replies under 40 words

Vesper sometimes answers in four sentences; that's too long to hear while walking.

Characters never say the exact words that solve a challenge

The game gives its own hints; the model should only nudge.

Let SmartSpecs comment on what the runner is looking at

Send a frame from the glasses camera with the question so the reply can mention the scene.

Stream character replies so speech starts sooner

Start speaking the first sentence while the rest is still arriving.

Handle rate limiting from the Meta API

When the model API says slow down, play a static line and try once more.

Push-to-talk clips lose the last word

Recording stops a beat too early; give the silence detector a longer tail.

Answer in the runner's language

If the runner speaks Spanish, the character should reply in Spanish.

Give HUSH its own persona prompt

HUSH talks in fragments and should never sound helpful.

Grade character replies automatically

Check fifty sample prompts for length, banned words and invented places, with no model as the judge.

Boost character names in transcription

"Vesper" keeps coming back as "whisper".

Characters forget what the runner just said

Keep the last few turns of the conversation in every request.

Return an emotion with each reply

Ask for structured output with the line and a mood so the voice can change tone.

Make the obvious failure obvious when the model key is missing

Health should say characters are off and the admin page should warn.

Accept an answer only above a transcription confidence

Low-confidence transcripts should ask the runner to repeat.

Retry transcription once on a server error

A single 502 from the speech service shouldn't fail the challenge.

Cut the persona prompts down to save tokens

They repeat the same rules three times.

Compare two versions of Vesper's prompt

Run both on the same twenty questions and keep the one runners prefer.

Measure how long each character takes to answer

Log time to first word per character and model.

Recap the run in the character's voice at the end

After the outro, Vesper sums up the runner's night in two sentences.

Try the smallest effort setting for one-line answers

See whether minimal effort is good enough for yes/no replies.

Hints from a photo of a landmark

The runner snaps the fountain and the character says whether they're close.

Open every run on HUSH

Play HUSH's prologue before Vesper breaks in on the station.

Rename the Deck to SmartSpecs everywhere

Dialogue, labels and the layer list still say Deck in places.

Move the station to 93.3

Some lines still give the old frequency.

Keep the choice signal off the lawn

The Winter Village covers the lawn around Halloween; move that signal to the 42nd Street walkway.

Announce the unlocked soundtrack after the run that earns it

Vesper and SmartSpecs should both mention Dead Channel when it unlocks.

Reject missions with an empty cast

The mission check should fail when there are no characters or two share an id.

Rewrite the opening so Vesper recruits the runner

She explains SmartSpecs can capture a soundwave before HUSH erases it.

Signals can sit above or below the runner

Give each signal an authored elevation so it sounds like it's up on a ledge or down a stairwell.

Write a second mission for Washington Square Park

Same eight-signal shape, new characters for the arch and the fountain.

Branching ending depending on whether the runner sided with HUSH

Two outros, chosen from the story flag.

Side quest for the archivist with three optional signals

Optional, and finishing it unlocks an extra line from the archivist.

Lines for when the runner stands still too long

After two minutes without moving, a character checks in.

Kilo sounds too much like Vesper

Rewrite Kilo's lines so the two are easy to tell apart by ear.

Halloween version of the prologue

Swap two lines and the HUSH sting for the Halloween weekend.

Translate the mission script into Spanish

Every scripted line and hint, with the same timing.

Signals four and five are too far apart

There's a 600 metre walk with nothing happening; move one or add a beat in between.

New challenge type: a riddle

The character asks a riddle and the runner answers out loud.

A rival runner who taunts over the radio

A new character who shows up after the third signal.

What the characters say when the phone loses its location

Under trees the position jumps; cover it with a line instead of silence.

Captions for every scripted line

For deaf and hard-of-hearing players.

Mari's backstory contradicts the archivist

Pick one version and fix the lines that disagree.

Guide for writers: how to place a signal

Explain radius, elevation and how far apart signals should be.

Shorten the prologue

Playtesters skipped it; get it under a minute.

Keep signal names hidden until they're found

The layer list should show static until the runner captures each one.

Tutorial signal right at the start

Teaches scanning before the real hunt begins.

Unlock lines for the premium soundtrack

What Vesper says the first time a premium player hears it.

Challenge where the runner hums the melody back

Unlocks the stem when the hummed rhythm matches.

Final confrontation with HUSH

A last exchange before the outro, different for each choice.

Hard mode with fewer hints

Hints only after the second wrong answer.

Twenty-minute version of the mission for event slots

Four signals instead of eight, same ending.

Vesper reads out the runner's stats at the end

Time, signals found, hints used.

Story choices should survive the app restarting mid-run

Flags are lost if the phone kills the app.

Make the hints more specific after each wrong answer

The third hint should almost give it away.

Play the whole game in the phone's browser

No install: the page runs the engine and the audio, and the glasses connect as Bluetooth audio.

The glasses' touchpad should work as media keys in the browser

Route the game audio through a media element so play, next and previous reach the page.

Keep the screen on in pocket mode

Use the wake lock so the page doesn't sleep mid-run.

Simulated walk with a skip-challenge button for desk testing

So the whole run can be played without leaving the desk.

Record the spoken answer and upload it for transcription

Downsample to 16 kHz mono WAV in the page before sending.

Typing fallback when the microphone is blocked

Show the hint chips and a text box instead.

Keep recordings on the device

Store them in the browser's database, not on the server.

Use the browser's own voice when signed out

Read the lines with speech synthesis if there's no account.

Render signal elevation in the browser

Above and below should come through the panners like they do on Android.

iPhone Safari won't play the Ogg stems

Serve a format Safari decodes, or decode them ourselves.

Let people add the player to their home screen

Manifest, icon and a proper standalone launch.

Show the map of found signals at the end of a run

A simple map with the eight pins and the route walked.

Audio stutters on older Android phones in Chrome

Find what's blocking the audio thread.

Duck the music when a character speaks

The voice is hard to hear over the full mix.

Landscape layout for tablets

The controls overlap the status text.

Work offline once the run has started

Cache the mission and stems so a dead zone doesn't stop the game.

Show a level meter while the runner is answering

So they can see the mic is hearing them.

Spatial audio sounds flat in Firefox

Panning works in Chrome but not there.

Pick up a run where it left off after reloading the page

Progress is lost on refresh.

Keyboard shortcuts for desk testing

Space to scan, H for a hint, R to repeat.

Subtitles for what the character is saying

On screen, as the line plays.

Vibrate when a signal locks on

Phones that support it give a short buzz.

The unlocked layers drift out of time after ten minutes

New stems start a little late compared with the bar.

Accessibility pass on the play page

Labels, contrast and focus order.

Choose the microphone on desktop browsers

Laptops with several inputs pick the wrong one.

Progress bar while the stems download

The first run looks frozen on slow connections.

Tap-to-start screen so iPhones unlock audio

Audio stays silent until there's a tap.

Smooth the compass in the browser

The heading jitters a lot on some phones.

Connect to the glasses through Meta's toolkit

Start a session, read the touchpad and head motion, and use the glasses' microphone.

Mix the stems in 3D on the phone

A built-in binaural mixer that places each signal around the runner.

Route editor on the operator screen

Walk the venue and drop each signal where you're standing.

Use the media buttons when the toolkit isn't available

So the touchpad still works with ordinary Bluetooth.

Download published soundtracks and check them

Fetch each stem once, verify its checksum and play it from the phone.

Sign in from the setup screen

Finished runs follow the account between phones.

Link these glasses for premium

Send the pair's details for an admin to approve.

Enroll event glasses from the operator screen

Pairs from the event box give premium as soon as someone links them.

Sign every build with the same key

So a newer build installs over the old one without losing progress.

Push-to-talk answers sent to the server for transcription

Record until silence and upload the clip.

Stop asking for cloud voices the server doesn't have

Every new line waits for a request that always fails.

Render signal elevation in the phone's audio engines

Both the built-in mixer and the FMOD renderer.

The app crashes if location permission is denied

Ask again or explain instead of crashing.

Battery drains fast during a forty-minute run

Find what's keeping the CPU awake.

Notification shows the wrong signal name

The foreground notification lags one signal behind.

Update Meta's wearables toolkit to the newest release

Check the session and input calls still work.

Heading drifts when the glasses disconnect

Fall back to the phone's compass cleanly.

Store release build with its own signing key

For the Play Store, kept out of the repository.

Change the server address without reinstalling

An option in settings for testing against a local server.

Build fails on JDK 21

Gradle complains about the toolchain.

Volume buttons do nothing during a run

They should change the game's volume.

Run history screen

List past runs with time and signals found.

Audio to the glasses drops after a phone call

Reconnect to Bluetooth audio afterwards.

Cut the app size down

The stems make the download over sixty megabytes.

Show the glasses' battery on the run screen

Warn below twenty percent.

FMOD renderer crashes on 32-bit phones

Either fix the native library or disable FMOD there.

Predictive back gesture breaks the run screen

Swiping back ends the run without asking.

Leak in the game service after a run ends

Memory keeps climbing across runs.

Show whether the glasses are linked on the account section

Linked, waiting for approval or not linked.

Keep playing when the server can't be reached

Characters fall back to written lines without errors.

Mock glasses stopped connecting for desk tests

The simulated device never reaches the started state.

Smooth the runner's position near tall buildings

GPS jumps across the street and triggers the wrong signal.

Keep running with the screen off

The run pauses when the phone locks on some devices.

Crash when rotating during calibration

The calibration screen loses its state.

Player and admin accounts

Sign up, sign in, password hashing and sessions that renew while in use.

Payment link with automatic premium

Stripe or Lemon Squeezy webhooks switch premium on when someone pays.

Hold payments that come in without an account

Show them to an admin to apply instead of trusting an unverified email.

Premium-only soundtracks

Free players see them as locked and can't download their stems.

Approve glasses links from the admin page

A tab listing pending pairs with approve and turn-down buttons.

Limit sign-ups and sign-ins per address

Without blocking a whole venue that shares one Wi-Fi.

Use the player's real address behind the proxy

Read the forwarded address so limits apply per player.

Rate limiter maps never shrink

Evict buckets once they've filled back up.

Two sign-ups at once can create duplicate accounts

Hash first, then check the email under the lock.

An admin session should end when the account loses admin

Check the role on every request.

Map tiles don't load on the admin page

The tile server needs to know which site is asking.

Public reads for the mission, routes and tracks

Premium stems still need an account.

Password reset by email

Send a link that expires in an hour.

Verify the email address on sign-up

Until then, payments can't attach by email.

Link to manage the subscription from the account page

Open the payment provider's customer portal.

Export a player's data when they ask for it

Account, runs and linked glasses as one file.

Search players by email on the admin page

The list is getting long.

Handle a refunded payment

Premium should switch off when a payment is refunded.

Log what admins change

Who granted premium or changed a role, and when.

Two-step sign-in for admin accounts

An authenticator code on top of the password.

Sign out other devices after a password change

Old sessions should stop working.

Error when the data disk is full

The server answers 500 instead of saying what's wrong.

Upload a soundtrack bigger than forty megabytes

Long stems hit the size limit.

Leaderboard of the fastest runs

Opt in, first names only.

Grant premium for a fixed number of days

For event attendees who should keep it for a month.

Lock sign-in after ten failed attempts

For an hour, per account.

Move accounts from JSON files into a database

The files are fine now but won't be at a thousand players.

Report free disk space in the health check

So we notice before uploads fail.

Deleting an account should also remove its runs and glasses links

Nothing should be left behind.

Discount codes for event attendees

A code that makes the payment link cheaper.

The server tests take too long

Split them so the slow ones only run in CI.

Run the server on the VPS behind Caddy with HTTPS

A systemd service on loopback, with Caddy getting the certificate.

Update script that tests on the server and rolls back

Pull, install, run the tests, restart, check health, and go back on failure.

Make the installer work from Windows PowerShell

The input redirect isn't supported there; copy the script over and run it instead.

Keep shell scripts with Unix line endings on Windows checkouts

Bash on the server can't run them with carriage returns.

Share Caddy with the storage service

Each app keeps its own site file in a folder the main config imports.

The engine check fails because the compiler reorders its output

Sort the parts that move before comparing.

Rebuild the browser engine after changing the game rules

The committed copy is stale and the check fails.

Publish every green build's APK to one release page

So the phone always has one place to download from.

Give V2 its own port, folder and subdomain

So it runs next to the original instead of replacing it.

Lint the deploy scripts in CI

Shellcheck and the unit file verifier on every push.

The engine can only be rebuilt correctly from Linux or macOS

Make the build the same on Windows.

Nightly backup of the data folder

Copy it off the VPS so accounts survive a disk failure.

Uptime check against the health endpoint

Ping it every five minutes and alert on failure.

Move the workflow actions off Node 20

GitHub is deprecating it on the runners.

Deploy automatically when main changes

Instead of running the update script by hand.

Staging subdomain for testing before release

Its own service and data on the same VPS.

Rotate the proxy's access logs

They'll fill the disk eventually.

Cache Gradle in CI

Builds take over ten minutes.

Only the proxy should reach the app's port

Tighten the firewall.

Renew the server's read-only deploy key

And document how.

Container image for running the server somewhere else

For a host that only runs containers.

Fail CI when the APK grows past eighty megabytes

Catch size creep early.

Alert when the VPS disk is ninety percent full

Before uploads start failing.

Run the Android tests on an emulator in CI

Only unit tests run today.

Point the DNS for the V2 subdomain at the VPS

Then run the installer for V2.

Review the systemd hardening options

Check the service can still write its data.

Build status badge in the README

So the state of main is visible at a glance.

Automatic dependency update pull requests

For npm and Gradle.

Stage each APK in the storage service, named by commit

So any build can be fetched later by its commit.

Route issues between the two coding agents

Label each new task for one agent and say why.

Check that every agent pull request has its handoff

What changed, what was verified and what wasn't.

Export routed issues as training data

Chat rows in the format the fine-tuning starter expects.

Train the routing model on the routed issues

LoRA fine-tune on Fireworks and compare against the rules.

Seed the router with example tasks

Hundreds of examples so the first training run has something to learn from.

Move an issue to review when its pull request opens

And back out of ready.

Keep one agent label when someone relabels a task

Treat the change as an override and note it.

Deploy the tuned routing model and switch it on

Set the model path and the API key in the repository settings.

Compare the rules and the model on held-out tasks

Show both scores in the workflow summary.

Route by size as well as by area

Big tasks to one agent, small ones to the other.

Add a third agent to the routing rules

And make sure the labels and review pairing still work.

Fall back to the rules when the routing model times out

Routing must never stop.

Weekly summary of what each agent finished

Posted as an issue comment.

Reward signal from merged pull requests

For reinforcement learning on the router later.

Review checklist in the agents' guide

What the reviewing agent must run before approving.

The routing keywords miss "speech to text"

Add the phrase to the rules.

Skip issues labelled question

Questions shouldn't be routed to an agent.

Count overrides per area

To see which rules are wrong most often.

Briefing for each agent with the commands to verify a build

References and constraints in one place.

Glitch out the signal names on the showcase page

Only the first should be readable, the rest found by playing.

Update the year in the licence

It still says last year.

Write the blurb for the hackathon submission

Two paragraphs on what it is and how it was built.

Record a demo video of a full run

Three minutes, glasses view plus the phone screen.

Add a code of conduct

For contributors to the public repository.

Fix the typos in the README

Several words are misspelled.

Design a logo for V2

Something that works as an app icon too.

Collect playtester feedback

A short form after each run.

Plan the event schedule at the park

Time slots, staff and the glasses box.

Hackathon submission checklist

Everything the judges need, with links.

Translate the README into Spanish

Keep both in the repository.

Blog post about building with two coding agents

What worked and what didn't.

Slides for judging

Five slides and the demo.
